note: NEGATIVE는 negative_allowed=true인 evidence에서만 반환. 그 외에는 부정 표현이 있어도 반환하지 않음(UNASKED). 런타임 추론 없음. 분류 기준: 질문 원문(question_en)이 단일 개념이면 SAFE, OR/AND/조건부/복합이면 UNSAFE. 같은 개념의 동의 표현 두 개(E_66, E_148)는 SAFE.

evidence.question_en: Have you recently had a viral infection?
Do you have swollen or painful lymph nodes?
Do you have pain that improves when you lean forward?
Have you been coughing up blood?

evidence.detail: '뚜렷하게 증가한 땀' — 땀 자체를 부정하면 전체 부정. '많이는 안'류 부분 부정은 버림
evidence.question_en: Have you had significantly increased sweating?

evidence.detail: '어딘가 통증' — '통증은 없어요/아픈 데 없어요' 같은 전체 부정 alias만 NEGATIVE, 부위별 부정은 POSITIVE 전용
evidence.question_en: Do you have pain somewhere, related to your reason for consulting?

evidence.detail: 숨참 = 숨쉬기 힘듦(같은 개념의 두 표현)
evidence.question_en: Are you experiencing shortness of breath or difficulty breathing in a significant way?
Do you have diabetes?
Are you significantly overweight compared to people of the same height as you?

evidence.detail: '색 있거나 많은 가래' — 가래 자체 부정만 NEGATIVE, 단순 가래 POSITIVE 없음
evidence.question_en: Do you have a cough that produces colored or more abundant sputum than usual?

evidence.detail: 과음/알코올 의존 — '술 안 마셔요/끊었어요'처럼 음주 자체를 부정하는 alias만
evidence.question_en: Do you drink alcohol excessively or do you have an addiction to alcohol?
Do you smoke cigarettes?

evidence.detail: 평소 활동 불가 OR 하루 종일 누움
evidence.question_en: Do you feel so tired that you are unable to do your usual activities or are you stuck in your bed all day long?
Do you constantly feel fatigued or do you have non-restful sleep?
Do you have a fever (either felt or measured with a thermometer)?
Do you have high blood pressure or do you take medications to treat high blood pressure?
Have you ever had a heart attack or do you have angina (chest pain)?

evidence.detail: 들숨 쌕쌕 OR 기침 후 거친 숨소리
evidence.question_en: Do you wheeze while inhaling or is your breathing noisy after coughing spells?
Have you had a cold in the last 2 weeks?
Do you have polyps in your nose?
Do you have a chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)?
Do you have asthma or have you ever had to use a bronchodilator in the past?

evidence.detail: 피부 병변 OR 발적 OR 문제
evidence.question_en: Do you have any lesions, redness or problems on your skin that you believe are related to the condition you are consulting for?
Are you feeling nauseous or do you feel like vomiting?

evidence.detail: '한 곳 이상 부종' — '부종/부은 데 없어요' 전체 부정 alias만, 부위별은 POSITIVE 전용
evidence.question_en: Do you have swelling in one or more areas of your body?

evidence.detail: 빠름 OR 불규칙 OR 두근거림(서로 다른 하위 유형)
evidence.question_en: Do you feel your heart is beating fast (racing), irregularly (missing a beat) or do you feel palpitations?
Is your nose or the back of your throat itchy?

evidence.detail: 새 피로 OR 막연한 불편 OR 근육통 OR 컨디션 변화
evidence.question_en: Have you noticed any new fatigue, generalized and vague discomfort, diffuse (widespread) muscle aches or a change in your general well-being related to your consultation today?
Do you have nasal congestion or a clear runny nose?
Do you have greenish or yellowish nasal discharge?
Have you had sexual intercourse with an HIV-positive partner in the past 12 months?
Have you noticed a high pitched sound when breathing in?
Do you have a cough?

evidence.detail: 예방접종 완료 여부(안 맞았다 = 전체 부정)
evidence.question_en: Are your vaccinations up to date?

evidence.detail: 목소리 낮아짐 OR 작아짐 OR 쉼
evidence.question_en: Have you noticed that the tone of your voice has become deeper, softer or hoarse?
Have you noticed a wheezing sound when you exhale?
Do you have pain that is increased with movement?

evidence.detail: 활동 시 악화 AND 휴식 시 완화
evidence.question_en: Do you have symptoms that are increased with physical exertion but alleviated with rest?
Do you have pain that is increased when you breathe in deeply?

evidence.detail: 기침 OR 힘주기 OR 무거운 것 들기 시 악화
evidence.question_en: Are the symptoms or pain increased with coughing, with an effort like lifting a weight or from forcing a bowel movement?
Are you more likely to develop common allergies than the general population?
